t: Malta Public Transport announces shuttle services for Puttinu Cares Good Friday Walk
html:
Malta Public Transport will be operating a series of dedicated shuttle services on Thursday 2 April 2026 to support participants taking part in the traditional Puttinu Cares Good Friday Marathon. The initiative will facilitate the transport of participants from Floriana to Mellieħa ahead of the overnight event, which will see participants walk back towards Floriana.

Participants will board buses from Triq Sarria in Floriana, in the vicinity of the Publiju bus stop, where a controlled boarding area will be set up. Event organisers will install a gazebo and barriers to manage queues and verify the Puttinu Cares ticket prior to boarding. Ticket checks will be handled by event personnel, and not by bus drivers, in line with Malta Public Transport operational procedures.

The first departures from Floriana to Mellieħa are scheduled to commence at approximately 20:30, with services running continuously throughout the evening. The final trip from Floriana is expected to depart at around 22:40, subject to demand.

This free, dedicated service forms part of Malta Public Transport’s ongoing commitment to support community initiatives and national events, while ensuring a safe and efficient experience for all participants.

Malta Public Transport extends its appreciation to its drivers and employees for supporting this worthy cause by voluntarily offering their services during this event.
